mechanism_narrative: A federal funds rate below 3.5% consistently compresses equity discount rates and stimulates risk appetite, producing positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days as measured by the direction_20d metric.
failure_condition: The 20-day forward return is negative in more than 55% of periods when FEDFUNDS is below 3.5%, or the Rank IC over a 3-year rolling window is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: A CPIAUCSL reading exceeding 335.0 signals persistent inflationary pressure that triggers central bank hawkishness, causing negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days as the market prices in higher interest rates.
failure_condition: The 20-day forward return is positive in more than 55% of periods when CPIAUCSL exceeds 335.0, or the Rank IC over a 3-year rolling window is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: Simultaneous declines in housing starts (HOUST) and retail sales (RSAFS) exceeding 0.5% indicate a broad-based demand contraction, causing S&P 500 declines over the next 20 trading days as investors anticipate reduced corporate earnings.
failure_condition: The 20-day forward return is positive in more than 55% of periods when both HOUST and RSAFS decline by over 0.5%, or the interaction effect Rank IC over a 3-year rolling window is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: In high-unemployment regimes (UNRATE > 4.5%), a monthly decline in unemployment rate exceeding 0.1 percentage points signals improving labor market conditions that boost consumer spending and corporate profits, driving positive S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: The 20-day forward return is negative in more than 55% of periods when UNRATE exceeds 4.5% and declines by over 0.1pp, or the Rank IC over a 3-year rolling window is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: An INDPRO reading below 100.0 indicates a contraction in industrial production, signaling reduced economic activity and potential corporate earnings deterioration, leading to negative S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: The 60-day forward return is positive in more than 55% of periods when INDPRO is below 100.0, or the Rank IC over a 3-year rolling window is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: A HOUST reading above 1500.0 signals strong housing market activity that indicates robust consumer demand and economic growth, driving positive S&P 500 returns over the next 5 trading days as the market prices in near-term economic strength.
failure_condition: The 5-day forward return is negative in more than 55% of periods when HOUST exceeds 1500.0, or the Rank IC over a 3-year rolling window is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: In supply contraction regimes (INDPRO < 100.0), a monthly decline in industrial production exceeding 0.5% intensifies fears of economic slowdown, causing negative S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: The 60-day forward return is positive in more than 55% of periods when INDPRO is below 100.0 and declines by over 0.5%, or the Rank IC over a 3-year rolling window is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: A PAYEMS reading above 160,000 (thousands) signals strong job growth that boosts consumer confidence and spending, driving positive S&P 500 returns over the next 5 trading days as the market prices in near-term economic strength.
failure_condition: The 5-day forward return is negative in more than 55% of periods when PAYEMS exceeds 160,000, or the Rank IC over a 3-year rolling window is below 0.03.
